statement: The marked lattice, theta-line-bundle and contracting-scale dictionary, including reversed meridians and the reference-scale ambiguity.
notes: The compatible scale is u=exp(-2 pi i c); an independently chosen reference multiplies it by an unspecified nonzero constant.

statement: The relative O and logarithmic-cotangent direct images and their cup maps are unchanged by admissible translation twists and multiplicities (3k,4l).
notes: Comparison is equality of invariant extensions on the common smooth family; finite nonreduced layers and the cusp are retained.

statement: All admissible one-component-cusp logarithmic transforms have the six cotangent direct images and Hodge diamond of Part A.
notes: Includes all (3,4) twists with |p|=1 and finite-fundamental-group members themselves.

statement: For coprime multiplicities (3k,4l), K=f*O(-1) O((k-1)S1+(3l-1)S2), h0q=(1,1,0,0), hp0=0 for p>0, and (h11,h12)=(2,1).
notes: The invariant relative determinant has exponents 2k and l; its evaluation vanishes to orders k-1 and 3l-1.

statement: The full anticanonical ring is the degree-d Veronese of C[x,y], deg(x,y)=(4l,3k), d=4l+3k-kl; the floor formula and all requested small pairs are computed.
notes: If d<0 only degree zero survives; d=0 is impossible under coprimality. Exact monomial and floor computations agree.

statement: The cyclic universal cover of degree n has connected fibres, n cusp normalization components, and unchanged O and logarithmic-relative cohomology bundles.
notes: The cusp dual complex is an actual connected index-n covering of the original torus, proved by etale pullback of strata.

statement: On the degree-n universal cover R1 Omega1 and R2 Omega2 acquire C_(p0)^(n-1); h11=h22=n+1 and h12=h21=1.
notes: Derived duality, including Ext1 of the residue skyscraper, is used rather than dualizing torsion naively.

statement: The cover has K=O(-2S2), anticanonical ring C[U,V] with weights (1,2), Betti numbers (1,0,n-1,0,n-1,0,1), and Frolicher degeneration at E2.
notes: Rational topology is independently proved by explicit Mayer-Vietoris matrices and cusp attachment cycles. Each nontrivial deck character contributes one Dolbeault class in each of bidegrees (1,1),(2,2).
